statement: NVIDIA secured 4.25 IT-GW of AI factory capacity at SB Energy's PORTS-Pike campus in Ohio with an option on the remaining 3.75 IT-GW, for a planned 8 IT-GW total dedicated to OpenAI under a 20-year lease, phasing online from 2028
why: An eight-gigawatt site contracted to a single model developer for two decades is committed forward demand for accelerators at a scale that only shows up in long-dated infrastructure deals.

impact.mechanism: Securing land, power and shell capacity that is exclusive to one vendor's compute converts multi-year power availability into a reserved pipeline of accelerator deployments for a named customer.

confidence.basis: Company-issued press release on NVIDIA's own newsroom, which the document notes also appears as an 8-K exhibit under NVIDIA's EDGAR filer number.

dispersion: 3.75 IT-GW of the 8 IT-GW total is an option rather than a secured commitment; capacity is dated from 2028 onward.
